pages.text:
## Meet Marcy
Marcy has dedicated her career in public service to fighting for all Ohioans to have a fair playing field as they seek economic and health security. A true daughter of Northwest Ohio, she still lives in her childhood home. Marcy has fought on the frontlines against unfair trade deals such as NAFTA, CAFTA, and China PNTR – standing up to her own party and special interests to do what is right. Marcy believes that government should be for and by the people, not corporate interests that have hollowed out our heartland.
Marcy Kaptur is a fighter for high-wage jobs, growing a workforce to meet the needs of the 21st century, and protecting our region’s most vital natural resource, the Great Lakes. She’s worked with both parties to secure investments in our communities and has been a true friend of veterans, seniors, first responders and working people. She’s a voice for us all in the People’s House.
## Support Marcy Kaptur

pages.title: Marcy’s Priorities - Marcy Kaptur
pages.text:
## Jobs & the Economy
Strengthening our economy is Marcy Kaptur’s top priority, and has been since she was first elected. Over several decades, unfair trade agreements, Wall Street recklessness, and federal policies favoring large corporations and the wealthy have decimated America’s middle-class and taken a toll on the very fabric of our nation. It’s time to put people first again.
In many parts of America, we know that people are still hurting after the Great Recession and a pandemic that has displaced workers. The costs of healthcare, prescription drugs, and stagnant wages present challenges for working Americans every day. Both political parties must come together to create jobs that Ohioans can live and raise a family on.
## Great Lakes
The Great Lakes Restoration Initiative brings vital funding to protect our most precious natural resources, but much work remains to be done. When President Trump attempted to zero out funding to the Initiative, Congresswoman Marcy Kaptur worked in a bipartisan manner to restore it – and the promise of clean, fresh water for our region.
The fight to stop harmful algal blooms and invasive species could not be more important to our region. Whether it’s the water we drink from, our fishing and tourism industries, or the simple importance of preserving the beauty of our coast, the stakes of a healthy Lake Erie are clear.
## Energy & Infrastructure
As the chair of the Energy and Water subcommittee on Appropriations, Congresswoman Kaptur works every day to bring green jobs to Northern Ohio. Whether it’s solar, wind, or biofuels, our region can lead us into a 21st century energy future that fosters American energy independence and brings down emissions to combat climate change.
Additionally, we need a new mindset that recognizes that our homes are an important part of our nation’s infrastructure. Congresswoman Kaptur is a champion of weatherization programs that increase home energy efficiency and bring down costs for citizens who need it most. President Biden’s Bipartisan Infrastructure Act delivers on this key priority, a success that will bring lower energy costs and increase property values in our region.
A one-size-fits all approach to housing will not work – some communities need new housing to bring down the cost of homeownership. Others have housing stock that must be rehabilitated after years of neglect following the 2008 financial crisis. Congresswoman Kaptur is a leader in efforts to increase the supply of affordable housing, while reducing the dangers of lead in legacy homes. She has introduced the Restoring Communities Left Behind Act to invest in both urban and rural communities that have seen disinvestment over the years.
## Agriculture & Nutrition
Congresswoman Kaptur has been passionate about agriculture her entire life. She knows the value of rich soil, and values the knowledge and wisdom of self-sustaining communities. This passion has manifested itself in a commitment to policies that support small farmers, lead to environmental best practices, and create economic opportunities in a changing world. The road to a healthy Lake Erie is not paved with the punishment of family farmers struggling to get by. Solutions to help families maintain farming traditions, as well as prevent the consolidation of farms and spread of absentee owners who aren’t invested in our communities must be found through consensus.
Additionally, supporting urban agriculture and the rehabilitation of urban ecosystems and natural resources is an urgent priority for the 21st century.
## Veterans, Defense, and Foreign Affairs
There can be no doubt: protecting our veterans and ensuring their health and wellness must be a priority without peer. As a member of the House Appropriations Defense Subcommittee, Congresswoman Kaptur has sought to secure the well-being of our veterans, while making sure our current military is equipped to promote liberty, ensure our national security, and build a future of clean energy independence.
Marcy Kaptur is a strong supporter of modern defense systems and equipment for our armed forces and supports Northern Ohio’s legacy as a leader in the nation’s defense industrial base. She has spearheaded major federal investments at Ohio’s defense bases including northern Ohio’s National Guard and Reserve assets such as the 180 TFW and Ottawa County’s Camp Perry. These investments resulted in our Guard bases ranking among the most modern, energy efficient bases in the U.S.
Congresswoman Kaptur is a strong believer that Congress, and not the president alone, must have a voice in defense actions. She voted against authorizing President Bush’s Iraq war powers. We must engage with allies to advance liberty and improve quality of life around the world.
## Wall Street
Wall Street has a serious accountability problem. The Great Recession destroyed 8.8 million jobs and wiped out $19.2 trillion of household wealth. Whether it was subprime lending, predatory lending practices, big banks selling mortgage securities without due diligence, or speculators betting on failure, greed has been allowed to warp our economy and put millions of hard-working Americans at risk.
The subsequent Dodd-Frank legislation did not go far enough. Commercial banking has not been separated from investment banking. Our financial institutions are still “too big to fail”. Our credit rating agencies have not been regulated. Community banks face too many hurdles to compete.
Congresswoman Kaptur has proposed the Return to Prudent Banking Act, which would reinstate the provisions of the Glass-Steagall Act to address these issues and more. This is also an issue of accountability – those who engage in financial crimes must face an equipped justice system. The congresswoman proposed and supported passage of the Financial Crisis Investigation Act which authorized the hiring of 1,000 agents and forensic experts to investigate financial crimes.
## Building the WWII Memorial
Congresswoman Marcy Kaptur has made support for America’s seniors, including veterans, a central pillar of her service. She led an effort that lasted nearly two decades to build the National World War II Memorial on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. resulting in a beautiful monument to the sacrifices of those who fought tyranny and oppression.
The Memorial is now one of the most visited sites in Washington, D.C. a fitting tribute to our Greatest Generation. The idea came from Berkey, Ohio constituent Roger Durbin and became a 17 year crusade for Congresswoman Kaptur. In 2004 at its unveiling, Mr. Durbin was posthumously honored for his inspiration.
## Campaign Finance
Campaign spending has skyrocketed in the years following the outrageous Citizens United decision. Billionaires and corporations are now free to pump millions of dollars into our elections without accountability. Our country’s very future as a democracy is at risk unless we achieve campaign finance reform. Marcy Kaptur knows we must reign in special interests and has supported legislation to repeal Citizens United, to limit spending in elections, and to improve access to the ballot for candidates.
Our elections cannot be up for sale to the highest bidder. Liberty requires safeguards on the influence of money in governance and elections.
## Support Marcy Kaptur

Marcy Kaptur knows we must reign in special interests and has supported legislation to repeal Citizens United, to limit spending in elections, and to improve access to the ballot for candidates. Our elections cannot be up for sale to the highest bidder. Liberty requires safeguards on the influence of money in governance and elections.

## Fighting for you.
Fighting for all Ohioans to have a fair playing field as they seek economic and health security.
## Meet Marcy
Marcy has dedicated her career in public service to fighting for all Ohioans to have a fair playing field as they seek economic and health security. A true daughter of Northwest Ohio, she still lives in her childhood home.
Marcy has fought on the frontlines against unfair trade deals such as NAFTA, CAFTA, and China PNTR – standing up to her own party and special interests to do what is right. Marcy believes that government should be for and by the people, not corporate interests that have hollowed out our heartland.
Marcy Kaptur is a fighter for high-wage jobs, growing a workforce to meet the needs of the 21st century, and protecting our region’s most vital natural resource, the Great Lakes. She’s worked with both parties to secure investments in our communities and has been a true friend of veterans, seniors, first responders and working people. She’s a voice for us all in the People’s House.

pages.title: Marcy’s Priorities - Marcy Kaptur
pages.text:
## Making Northwest Ohio More Affordable
Northwest Ohioans work hard for every dollar they earn. Marcy is fighting to make life more affordable for working families — taking on the powerful interests driving up the cost of everyday goods, while ending Washington’s corporate welfare that uses taxpayer dollars to bankroll giveaways for Billionaires, big corporations, and the well-connected. Marcy is fighting to:
Keep American Tax Dollars in American Communities by opposing foreign bailouts and endless wars that put Wall Street and foreign governments ahead of Northwest Ohio.
Lower Skyrocketing Utility Bills with an all-of-the-above energy approach that modernizes our aging grid, meets growing demand, and delivers reliable, affordable power for families and the industries that drive our regional economy. She’s also fighting to make massive data center companies pay their fair share for the power and water they consume instead of passing those costs onto ratepayers.
Put Homeownership Back Within Reach for hardworking families who are working, saving up, and doing everything their parents and grandparents did — but still can’t afford to buy a home. Marcy is taking on Billionaire and corporate investors buying up homes and driving up prices while working to expand the supply of affordable housing so more families can put down roots in Northwest Ohio.
Make Quality Health Care More Affordable and Accessible by taking on insurance companies and Big Pharma who are raking in massive profits while working people sink into medical debt. She is fighting to fully fund Medicare and Medicaid, restore Affordable Care Act tax credits, lower prescription drug prices, and protect families from surprise medical bills.
Lower the Cost of Child and Elder Care so no family has to choose between caring for a loved one and paying the bills. Whether you’re a young parent paying for daycare or a son or daughter looking after an aging parent, at some point all of us will need someone to care for us. Marcy is fighting to lower the cost of child care and long-term care for aging and disabled loved ones, because caring for family shouldn’t be a privilege reserved for the wealthy.
Protect Social Security and Medicare by demanding accountability for our tax dollars and standing up to Washington politicians who want to raid the benefits seniors spent a lifetime earning to pay for tax breaks for the wealthy.
## Jobs/Manufacturing/Labor
The daughter of a union organizer at Champion Spark Plug and a father who worked at Toledo Jeep, Marcy is proud to stand shoulder to shoulder with organized labor and the hardworking men and women who build, make, and grow the things that power our region. That’s why she led the fight against bad trade deals like NAFTA that shipped Ohio jobs overseas, opposed the Wall Street bailout, and pushed both Democrats and Republicans to crack down on China’s unfair trade practices.
That fight for Northwest Ohio’s workers carries into the next generation, too. Marcy believes building a good life shouldn’t require a four-year degree. If you’re willing to work hard, you deserve a fair shot at a good-paying job and the opportunity to build a secure future right here in Northwest Ohio. That’s why she’s investing in Northwest Ohio’s workforce – to bring good-paying jobs home, end tax breaks for companies that ship jobs overseas, and expand workforce training so our workers are prepared to thrive in the industries of the future.
## Keeping Northwest Ohio Safe and Secure
Marcy believes securing our border is a shared American responsibility — one we can solve if we work together to enforce our immigration laws, deport violent criminals, and give law enforcement the resources they need — all while protecting due process, accountability, and the rule of law.
Marcy has never been afraid to stand up to her own party to keep Northwest Ohio safe and secure. That’s why she has backed bipartisan and Republican-led legislation to strengthen border security, hire more than 10,000 Border Patrol agents, and secured funding for the Border Patrol station in Ottawa County and the 180th Fighter Wing’s Northern Border mission.
## Agriculture
Marcy has spent her career standing up for the farmers who feed America — taking on the food monopolies, voting for every major Farm Bill, and helping open new biofuel markets that put more money back in farmers’ pockets.
Family farms are the backbone of Northwest Ohio, and Marcy is working to keep them that way. She’s fighting to grow more of our food here at home, support small and family-owned farms and create the economic opportunities they need to preserve Northwest Ohio’s proud agricultural heritage for generations to come.
## Lake Erie
Our region’s greatest natural resource, Lake Erie provides the drinking water that flows from our taps, supports the harbors that keep our economy moving, and sustains the fishing industry so many hardworking families depend on.
Marcy has worked with both parties to restore funding for the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative – which helps protect Lake Erie from threats like toxic algal blooms – every time Washington politicians have tried to slash or eliminate it.
However, the fight is not over. Marcy will keep up the work to protect our drinking water, combat harmful algal blooms and invasive species, and preserve this vital resource for the people and communities that rely on it.
## Veterans
Marcy has always believed that Congress’s duty to support the brave men and women who fought for our country and defended our freedom is our moral obligation as a nation. That’s why she spearheaded the effort to build the National World War II Memorial on the National Mall, an idea from a local postal carrier and WWII veteran of the battle of Saint Lô that’s now one of the most visited sites in our nation’s Capital.
She also helped pass the PACT Act, marking the largest expansion of benefits and services for veterans in more than 30 years and secured funding for new state of the art VA clinics across northern Ohio.
But too many of our veterans are still struggling, and that’s why Marcy’s fighting to ensure every veteran can get the quality care they’ve earned through their service and sacrifice.
## Cleaning up Political Corruption
Marcy agrees that too many politicians in Washington would rather benefit from the status quo instead of fighting to fix it. That’s why she’s fighting to change the way Washington works and hold people in power accountable.
Marcy will work to end the special privileges politicians give themselves — banning members of Congress and their families from trading stocks and stopping Congressional pay raises.
She’s also taking on the powerful corporations driving up utility costs – reining in billion-dollar giveaways to massive data center companies, and cracking down on utility companies that use bribery and rate-rigging to pad their profits at families’ expense. Marcy will make these companies return every dime gained through corruption back to ratepayers and put executives who bribe and officials who take bribes behind bars.
And she’s finishing the fight she has led to release the Epstein Files — demanding the entire files be made public and those involved be held accountable, regardless of their party, wealth, connections, or power.
